profile.information: own roster, full public opponent roster, own artifacts, own doctrine/budget, public placement map; no hidden enemy setup or formation
profile.placement: same incumbent final formation; no paid placement
profile.opponent: current locked V3 with current conditional setup
profile.runtimeRevalidation: if the shipped default changes, this result does not automatically qualify the new combined profile

candidate.funding: unchanged protected-axis plan; spare nonpreferred physical point then Armor
candidate.fallback: exact incumbent for nonmagic, private or incomplete context and partial remaining budgets

training.reclassifiedDevelopment: original432 training plus BOTH already-opened864 qualification banks; prior failed gates and closed confirmation banks remain unchanged
training.preflight: first27 training boards x4 cases repeated on both hosts, exact prior control outcomes/input/formation/traces
training.reuse: only exact plan and reconstructed input hash; every reused row retains original file/line/hash provenance
training.selection: fivefold whole-board cross-validation, positive in at least3 folds and overall gain>=0.5pp; largest overall gain then earlier recipe; one refit before fresh qualification

gates.independentUnit: offer board; both draft assignments and physical seats
gates.confirmation: only if qualification passes; same frozen fit and gates, no replacement after opening
